description: Update an existing custom object record by schema key and record ID.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

associations.description: Array of association objects to set on this record

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

owners.description: Array of user IDs who own this record

properties.description: Key-value map of field values to update

name: crm_update_object_record
